register.title: Evan Daniel's n236 certificate at 5ad0069, issue659
register.headline: A smaller packing of 236 squares from Evan Daniel's basin explorer, from a rebuild of Chaoweeraprasit's composition
register.source_checks: The author reports that his two exact rational checkers, verify_cert.py (separating axes) and verify_cert2.py (polygon intersection), accept the certificate and its regularized display view. The side is the 80-digit KKT point of s236_bm3c.exact.txt made rigorous by the source's exactsolve.py; the source reports a local minimum strict modulo 92 exact flat motions, no corner-corner MILP descent, 114 corner-corner contacts and 18 rattlers, and measures it against #481's packing as a different local minimum with no tilt angle shared and 20 load-bearing squares moved by more than 1e-2. Those are numerical evidence, as the source says, not proofs.
register.credit: Credit Evan Daniel (https://github.com/evand/square-packing), whose basin explorer found the packing, and credit Nate Chaoweeraprasit's (itsnaka, SQUISH) Mondrian composition of issue 481 (T-136) for the construction, as the author asks: a replication test rebuilt #481's composition at 236 from the two pieces #481 names, Kingbird's s(152)_r2 corner piece and Chaoweeraprasit's s(88) of issue 422, and fixed-side perturbation and re-polish descended below #481's side. The issue and the pinned commit state that the work was done with Claude (Claude Code) and approved by Evan Daniel.
register.next_rung: Independently review the retained replay, then adopt at 236: the certificate is below the case's ceiling (T-146) and below PR 574's T-174, staged for adoption there, by 2.02e-3, and below every report at 236. Final exact-head CI remains required.

bibliography.note: One complete exact certificate at 5ad00693899ef50ccf6502f0346187cc422cc914, s(236) <= 7930967195303679308621899285697/(5*10^29), from the author's basin explorer started from his rebuild of Nate Chaoweeraprasit's #481 Mondrian composition (Kingbird's s(152)_r2 corner piece and Chaoweeraprasit's #422 s(88)); the author credits the construction to #481 and calls the packing a different local minimum from it. A regularized display view of the same packing at the same side, and the source's comparison with #481's packing, are retained beside it, with the source's two exact checkers. MIT-licensed certificates and solver reports retained; Claude assistance disclosed. KKT and jamming statements are the author's numerical evidence; no local or global optimality claim.
